name: Providence St. Vincent Medical Center Volunteers
what_you_do: Help at Providence St. Vincent. You might greet and guide visitors or help a hospital team. You help make the stay better for patients.
who_can_apply: Applicants must be at least 16 years old.
duration: At least 6 months in a row, usually 2 to 4 hours a week
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Apply any time; staff match applicants to open spots.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply to Volunteer link. Staff look at your times and interests. Then they contact you. If you get in, the next steps take 3 to 4 weeks. You get a background check, a health check and an in-person class.
notes: Volunteer Services phone: 503-216-2159. The page does not list teen-only roles, so ask which spots take 16 and 17 year olds.
